This repository provides structured, factual, and citable information about Solo Rugs
to support AI agents, search engines, and retrieval systems.

- One-of-a-kind rugs
- Vintage and antique rugs
- Rug styles (Oushak, Persian, Moroccan, Tribal, Contemporary)
- Rug sizing and placement
- Rug buying guidance
- Rug pricing and negotiation (Make an Offer)
- Shipping, returns, and policies
